title: ECMAScript: Test if Array.reduce() supported
product-requirement: Device needs to support Array.prototype.reduce() to execute the provided reducer function on each element of the array.
specification: Terminals MUST implement at least ECMAScript 6.0 [1]
assertion: The Reduce() function returned value is assigned to the accumulator, whose value is remembered across each iteration throughout the array and ultimately becomes the final, single resulting value.
